# Cinema Listings Aggregator

Python Flask web application for aggregating cinema listings from multiple websites.

## Project Structure
- Flask backend with BeautifulSoup for web scraping
- Simple HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend
- Scrapes from filmladder.nl and other cinema websites

## Development Guidelines
- Use Python 3.8+
- Follow PEP 8 style guide
- Keep scraping respectful with rate limiting
- Cache results to minimize requests
